text.body: śrīhammīramahākāvyam prathamaḥ sargaḥ sadācidānaṃdamahodayaikahetuṃ paraṃ jyotirūpāsmahe tat | yasmin śivaśrīḥ sarasīva haṃsī viśudvikṛdvāriṇi raṃramīti ||1|| tajjñānavijñānakṛtāvadhānāḥ saṃtaḥ parabrahmamayaṃ yamāhuḥ | padmāśrayaḥ klṛptabhavāvasānaḥ sa nābhibhūrvastvaratāṃ śivāya ||2|| yaśodayāsphītaśubhapravṛttirgopālamālārcitapādapadmaḥ | śrīvatsalakṣmā puruṣottamaḥ śrīpārśvaḥ śriyaṃ vastanutādatanvīṃ ||3|| ucairvṛṣo darpakadarpahārī śivānuyāto vilasadvibhūtiḥ | śubhrāsthitinaiirdalitāṃdhakāraḥ śrīśaṃkaro vīravibhurvibhūtyai ||4|| sañcakrahṛtprītikaraiḥ prabhāviprabhāviśeṣaiḥ subhagaṃbhaviṣṇuḥ | samyakprabodhaprathanaprabhūṣṇu rbhāsvān saśāṃtiḥ śamayatvaghāni ||5|| maheśacūḍāmaṇicuṃbipādo 'bhrāṃtasthitiḥ sphītaśubhapracāraḥ | mahāmahādhvastatamassamūhaḥ samudrajanmā śaśabhṛcchriye stāt ||6|| lasatkavistomakṛtorubhakti rnālīkasaṃpatsubhagaṃbhaviṣṇuḥ | svadarśanena trijagatpunānā sarasvatī no nayatātprasattiṃ ||7|| mādhātṛsītāpatikaṃkamukhyāḥ kṣitau kṣitīṃdrāḥ katināma nāsan | teṣu stavārhaḥ parameṣa satvaguṇena hammīra mahībhṛdekaḥ||8|| satvaikavṛtteḥ kila yasya rājyaśriyo vilāsā api jīvitaṃ ca| śakāya putrīṃ śaraṇāgatāṃśvā prayacchataḥ kiṃ tṛṇamapyabhūvan ||9|| śrīhammīramahākāvye atosya kiṃciccaritaṃ pravaktu micchāmi rājanyapupūṣayāhaṃ | tadīyatattadguṇagauraveṇa vigāhya nunnaḥ kiṃla karṇajāhaṃ ||10|| kaitasya rājñaḥ sumahaccaritraṃ kvaiṣā punarme dhiṣaṇā'ṇurūpā | totimohāddhujayaikayaiva mugdhastitīrṣāmi mahāsamudraṃ ||11|| guruprasādādyadi vāsmi śakta stadīyavṛttastavanaṃ vidhātuṃ | sudhākarotsaṃgataraṃgayogānmṛgo na khe khelati kiṃ sakhelaṃ ||12|| śrīcāhamānānvayamaulimauli rbabhūva hammīranarādhipastat | aitahyato vacmi purā tadīyā mutpattimutpāditaharṣahelāṃ ||13|| yajñāya puṇyaṃ kvacana pradeśaṃ draṣṭuṃ vidhātu rbhramataḥ kilādau | prapetivat puṣkaramāśupāṇipadmātparābhūtamivāsya bhāsā ||14|| tataḥ śubhaṃ sthānamidaṃ vibhāvyaṃ prārabdhayajño yamapāstadainyaḥ | viśaṃkya bhītiṃ danujavrajebhyaḥ smerasya sasmāra sahasraraśmeḥ ||15|| avātaranmaṃḍalatothabhāsāṃ patyuḥ.pumānudyatamaṃḍalāgraḥ | taṃ cābhiṣicyāśvadasīyarakṣāvidhau vyadhādeṣa makhaṃ sukhena ||16|| papāta yat puṣkaramannapāṇeḥ khyātaṃ tataḥ puṣkaratīrthametat | yaccāyamāgādatha cāhamānaḥ.pumānato 'khyāyi sa cāhamānaḥ||17|| tataścaturvaktrabhavātprasādāt sāmrājyamāsādya sa dhāhamānaḥ| cakre'rkavadbhūbhṛta āśupādākrāṃtān gurūnapyayamasya vaptāṃ ||18|| svadānajanmoruyaśorjitaśrīvilopi dānaṃ samavekṣya yasya | baliḥ sa pātālabilaṃ siṣeve trapāturāṇāmaparā gatiḥ kā!?||19|| tvaṃ pāpa re kāmayase madīyāṃ kīrti śaśī yena ruṣeti ruddhaḥ| biṃbaṃ raverdivyāmavaṃ pradātuṃ praviśya nirgacchati māsi māsi ||20|| pratāpavahniṃ rbvalito yadīya stathā dviṣāṃ kīrtivanānyadhākṣīt | tadutthadhūmāśrayato jahāti viyadyathā 'dyāpi na kālimānaṃ ||21|| niśamya suprītamanā yadīyāṃ kīrti vicitrorucaritraramyāṃ | mahītaladhvaṃsabhiyā śiraḥ sva makaṃpayastāpapracāpa śeṣaḥ ||22|| pūrvajavarṇanam jayaśriyā prāptamahāviyogānsamūrchayan vairigaṇānnikāmaṃ| yo yudhyavācī pavanāyitopi citraṃ dvijivhānna sukhīcakāra ||23|| praspardhatte madāśasā 'syaṃ sūnuḥ śaśītyamarṣāt kila yoṃ'burāśeḥ | gāṃbhīryalakṣmīṃ haratisma kinna sutāparādhe janakasya daṃḍaḥ? ||24|| tadā 'khyayā jāyata cāhamānavaṃśa strilokīvihitapraśaṃsaḥ | śaśvat suparvāvalisevyamāna utpattihetu rnaramauktikānāṃ ||25|| tasmin sphuradvikramacakravālā vaṃśe babhūvu rbahavo nṛpālāḥ | trivargasaṃsargapavitracitracaritravitrāsitapāpabhārāḥ ||26|| parākramākrāṃtajagatkrameṇā bhavannṛpo dīkṣitavāsudevaḥ | śakrāsurān jetu mihāvatīrṇaḥ svayaṃ dharāyāmiva vāsudevaḥ ||27|| sapatnasaṃghātaśirodhisaṃdhicchedādasiṃ kuṃṭhataraṃ nije yaḥ | pratāpavahnāvabhitāpya kāma mapāyayattadramaṇīdṛgaṃbu ||28|| chinnadviṣanmaṃḍalamaulimūlāsṛkpūradigdhāsilatāchalena | raṇājire yasya kare vireje vyaktānurāgeva bhṛśaṃ jayaśrīḥ ||29|| pravādyamāne raṇavādyarvṛṃde saṃpaśyamāneṣu divaḥ sureṣu | śauryaśriyaṃ yo raṇaraṃgabhūmā vanarttayadvelladasicchalena ||30|| bhāsvān jito yanmahasā dadāti jhaṃpāṃ kimadyāpi na vārirāśau | unmajjati vyākulito 'nvahaṃ ca sudustyajaṃ hā! hatajīvitavyaṃ ||31|| tadaṃgajanmā 'jjani nābhijanmārhaṇācaṇaḥ śrīnaradevabhūpaḥ | tanūdarīlocanalobhanīyatanuśriyā tarjitakāmarūpaḥ ||32|| aśātravaṃ viśvamidaṃ vidhātuṃ kruddhe paribhrāmyati yatra bhūpe | rājyaśriyaṃ pātumarātayasvakośādvasūnpācakṛṣurna khaḍgān ||33|| saṃkhyeṣu pūrvācalacūḍaśobhāṃ bāhuryadīyaḥ kalayāṃbabhūva | mlāniṃ nayanvairimukhāṃbujāni rarāja yasmin navacaṃdrahāsaḥ ||34|| pratāpavahni rjvalito yadīyaḥ sthāne yadanyāyavanānyadhākṣīt | gajjanāścaryakaraṃ tadetat yadvairiṇāṃ kaṃpabharaṃ tatāna ||35|| śrīhammīramahākāvye nakhāvalīnāṃ kapaṭena putrapautrānvitopyeṣa patirdvijānāṃ | jitohametat yaśasetyupetya lagno yadīye padapadmayugme ||36|| śrīcaṃdrarājñena nayaikadhāptā tato dharitrī biṃbharāṃbabhūve | vaktreṇa kīrtyā ca niśākaraṃ dvi rjayan svanāmā'tata yo yathārthaṃ ||37|| yasya pratāpajvalanasya kiṃci dapūrvamevājani vasturūpaṃ | jajvāla śatrau sarase prakāmaṃ yannīrase'smin praśaśāma sadyaḥ ||38|| cāpasya'yaḥ svasya cakāra jīvākṛṣṭiṃ raṇe kṣeptumanāḥ śaraughān | javena śatrūn yamarājaveśma 'naiṣīttadevanmahadava citraṃ ||39|| yasya kṣitīśasya ca yanmahāse ranyonyamāsītsumahān virodhaḥ | eko virāgaḥ samabhūtpareṣāṃ dāreṣu cānyo yadabhūtsarāgaḥ ||40|| tasmādaśobhiṣṭa mahiṣṭhadhāmā mahīmaheṃdro jayapālanāmā | yaḥ siddhavidyo jagati prasiddhiṃ jagāma cakrītijitāricakraḥ ||41|| bhinnadviṣatkuṃbhighaṭākaṭhāhakuṃbhocchalacchoṇitaśoṇaśociḥ | yasyāhave khaṅgalatā pratāpāśuśukṣaṇe rarcirivolalāsa ||42|| anekadhāṣṭāpadasāradānadakṣo vaśībhūtatarākṣacāraḥ | yo dyūtakṛdūccaturaṃgayuddhakrīḍāsvajñeyaḥ samabhūtpareṣāṃ ||43|| vidāritārātikarīṃdrakuṃbhavilagnamuktāphalakaitavena | kare yadīye karavālavallī jayaśriyo hāralateva reje ||44|| yatkīrttipūrairabhitaḥ parīte viśvatraye sūribhirityatarki | taptaṃ pratāpai rdhruvametadīyai rviliptametadbhavacaṃdanena ||45|| yadīyakīrtyāpahṛtāṃ samaṃtāt nijāṃ śriyaṃ svargadhunī vibhāvya | patatpravāhadhvanikaitaveṃna kāmaṃ kimadyāpi na phūtkaroti || 46 || raṇe kaṇedṛtya nipīya raktamadhūnyarīṇāṃ vadanāṃbujeṣu | śilīmukha yasya samaṃtatopi kṣībā iva kṣoṇitalaṃ sma yāṃti ||47|| yasya prasarpaddiṣamāyudhasya pratyārthināṃ saṃgarasaṃgatānāṃ | svedaḥ prakaṃpo balahāniruccai sbhūdvadhūnāmiva vallabhasya ||44|| pūrvajavarṇanam sphuraddhṛtiḥ prāptalasatpratiṣṭho viśuddhavarṇaḥ spṛhaṇīyavṛttaḥ | kīrtiṃ smaransatkavivatparārthahatau matiṃ kvāpi na yaśrcakāra ||49|| viruddhavāsādiha māṃ na kopi vettīti bibhyatkila yatpratāpāt| dārūṇi vahniḥ praviveśa noce ttadgharṣaṇāttatprabhavaḥ kutaḥ syāt ||50|| kāmaṃ yadojaḥ sṛji vedhasopi svedodayaḥ kopi sa āvirāsīt | prasarpatā yena nadīvadaṃburāśerapi kṣāramakāri vāriṃ ||51|| tadvāstu tattaddhanavastusāraprāgbhāravīkṣāstutadhātṛsargaṃ | svargaśriyāṃ jitvarakāṃtikāṃtamatiṣṭhipat yo'jayamerudurgaṃ ||52|| adīpi tasmājjñayarājñabhūpa strailokyavikhyātayaśaḥsvarūpaḥ | yatkīrticaṃdrairmukhamaṃḍalāni dikkāminīnāṃ surabhībabhūvuḥ ||53|| yaśo vitāne sphurite yadīye vyakto yadā'lakṣi na śītaraśmiḥ | tadādiśaṃke vidhinā vyadhāyi tadīyabiṃbāṃtarayaṃ kalaṃkaḥ ||54|| yasminmahīṃ śāsati rājamārgaprollaṃghanaṃ tuṃgasurālayeṣu | nistriṃśatā'streṣu mado dvipeṣu karagraho'bhāt karapīḍaneṣu ||55|| jagatpradīpe kimu yatpratāpe pataṃgavadyānnipapāta bhāsvān | pataṃga ityetadamuṣya nāmā 'nyathā kavīṃdrāḥ kathaṃ māmanaṃti ||56|| satyaṃ kilaikodarajopi caikanakṣatrajñātopi sadṛgbhavenna | apyekatoseḥ samamasya jñāta muṣṇaṃ yadojaḥ śiśiraṃ yaśastu||57|| sāmaṃtasiṃho nṛpatistato'bhāt mattaridaṃtāvalavārasiṃhaḥ.| yasya pratāpairjayatoricakraṃ babhūva bhūṣaivaṃ kṛpāṇadaṃḍaḥ ||58|| aho ahīrātramahodayaśrī ryaśaḥśaśī yasya navo babhāse | nānyāyasiṃhīsutalabdhabhīti rnāmitradhārādharalubdhakāṃti1||59|| mahībhṛtāṃ mūrdhasu yatpratāpo bhāsvānnavo bhātkila yaḥ prasarpan | tatāpa śatrūn vidhṛtātapatrāṃ styaktātapatrānna punaḥ kadācit ||60|| pispardhiṣū eṣa mameṃdvahīnau pātīti kopādiva yasya kīrtiḥ || jaṭāsvaṭat svastaṭinī chalenāruroha mauliṃ himaraśmimauleḥ ||61|| spardhāṃ vidhitsoḥ saha yena saṃkhye svasyāvivekatvaviluptabuddhaiḥ | tṛṇāni dadbhirdadhataḥ paśutva manāgase smārigaṇā gadaṃti || 62 || tatobhajadrājyaramāmanaṃtānaṃtāpati rgūyakanāmadheyaḥ | yenāniśaṃ dharmatarūrdharitryā mutsarganīraraibhiṣicyatesma || 63 || uddāmadhārājalavālikaṃ yatkarāṃtarāle karavālameghaṃ | abhyunnataṃ vīkṣya vipakṣamānahaṃsodbhutaṃ mānasatopyaneśat || 64 || uccārayanvairipaśūṃstṛṇāni nistriṃśadaṃḍaṃ ca kare dadhānaḥ | niraṃtaraṃ bhūṣitasarvadehaḥ satyāṃ vitene nijagopatāṃ yaḥ || 65 || pralāyitānāṃ ripubhūpatīnāṃ piban kaṇehatya yaśaḥpayāṃsi | tatstraiṇaniśvāsasamīrapuṣṭo yasyāsidaṃḍo bhujagāyatesma || 66 || tannaṃdana śrcaṃdanavajjanānā mānaṃdano naṃdananāmadheyaḥ | nihatya śatrūnsamare samagrān svasāccakārāvanimā samudraṃ || 67 || ālokamātreṇa śubhāni purṣṇai statvārthadṛṣṭyā ca tamāṃsyapāsyan | prajā vivasvāniva vṛttaramyaḥ saṃvardhayāmāsa niraṃtaraṃ yaḥ || 68 || puraḥ pareṣāṃ kila pakṣapātaṃ vihāya ke nādhikamāhurenaṃ | nājau yathādīdṛśadeṣa pṛṣṭhaṃ nijaṃ tathā vaktramah parepi || 69 || puraḥ pareṣāṃ kila pakṣapātaṃ vihāya kenādhikamāhurenaṃ | yathā svakośādaṃyamācakarṣa khaṅgaṃ tathājau vasu vairiṇopi || 70 || yasya pratāpo bhuvi vāḍavādhikṣepādyadaṃhaḥ kalayāṃbabhūva | tatsaṃpramārṣṭuṃ kimasau praviṣṭaḥ pārṃbudhestīratapovanāni || 71 || bhayārttavaprāyitabāhudaṃḍaḥ sarvāstravidyopaniṣatkaraṃḍaḥ | līlāparābhūtasuparvarājaḥ kṣmābhṛttato rājataṃ vaprarājñaḥ' || 72 || jalatpratāpajvalanopataptā pratyarthibhūbhogajuṣāṃ jayaśrīḥ | yadiyanistriṃśaniśātadhārāpāte vyadhānmajjanasajjalīlāṃ || 73 || sarīsṛpasyāsya ca khaṅgayaṣṭe rākāramātrādyadi sāmyamāsīt| daṃṣṭvā haretprāṇagaṇānyadādmaḥ paro dviṣāṃ vīkṣitamātra eva || 74 || sarvātiśāyidyutinī vidhātrā vidhitsitaujo yaśasī yadīye | avaśyametau racitau praśasyābhyāsāya tigmadyutiśītaraśmī ||75|| śaṃke pratikṣmāpatikīrtilopa pāpopaśāṃtyai vidadhesya kīrtiḥ | snānaṃ muhurnākanadīpravāhe śubhratvamāsī tkathamanyathā syāṃ || 76 || apyastadoṣasya babhūva tasya doṣadvayaṃ kāmavaśitvalobhau | senāṃ kumārīṃ bubhuje mṛdhe ya llalau tathaiko vijayaśriyaṃ ca || 77 || yatkīrtigānaṃ viniśamya śaṃke haraḥ pranṛtyanprasaratpramodaḥ | chuṭajjaṭāniryadamartyasiṃdhupayaḥpravāhairiva śubhra āsīt || 78 || khelatsu bhūriṣvapi yācakeṣu dānaikalīlārasikasya yasya | dā pṛṣṭhacārī kila yo nakāro yadi priyosau na paraḥ kadācit||79|| analpasaṃkalpanakalpavallīṃ vipakṣapakṣavrajabhedabhallīṃ | trailokyalokāvalivaṃdyapādāṃ sevāparaprattamahāprasādāṃ || 80 || śākaṃbharīsthānakṛtādhivāsāṃ śākaṃbharīṃ nāma surīṃ prasādya | viśvāpatirviśvahitāya śākaṃbharyāṃ rumāṃ yaḥ prakaṭīcakāra || 81 || tato dharābhāramurīcakāra jitāricakro harirājabhūpaḥ | śakādhirājasya raṇe nihatya sanmānavanmugdhapuraṃ lalo yaḥ ||89|| raṇājire vairabhṛtāṃ bhaṭānā mekopi yo 'nekatayā cakāse | prapaśyatāṃ nirmalanīrapūrṇapātreṣu tārāpativajjanānāṃ || 83 || bhrāṃtvāpyadabhreṣu dharādhareṣu kutrāpyanāsāditayogyayogāḥ | paurā ivaudāryamukhā guṇāḥsma divāniśaṃ yasya pure vasaṃti ||84|| anena peṭhe paṭhatākṣarāṇi kiṃ no vṛthā bodhyathavā nidānaṃ | niṣedhato smānviśato niṣeddhu meveti yasminkavivāgvitarkaḥ||85|| asyā'vanīmaghavato'silatāṃburāśerastāghatā sumahatīti kimadbhutaṃ naḥ | asyādbhutādbhutamidaṃ tu sanīratāyāṃ | satyāmapi sphurati yajjaḍatā sma naiva || 86 || [daṃtapṛṣṭhaphaṇacakrasahasraiḥ] kroḍakūrmabhujagādhipā dadhuḥ | kṣmāṃ sukhena bhujayaikayā dadhattāmasāṃ vatata kaṃ na vismayaṃ||87|| udyacchauryavinirjitorjitaripustaṃberamaughonaghastrīsaṃcālitacārucāmarayugavyājeāllasatkesaraḥ | ātmīyāsanamāśrito vanajuṣā mīśasvabhāvaṃ dadhat | jajñe siṃha ivonnatakramagatiḥ śrīsiṃharāja stataḥ || 88 || etenotrāsitānāṃ pratidharaṇibhujāmullasadduryaśassu | sphūrjatparjanyamālālalitamupagateṣvājibhūmau samaṃtāt| kinna sthāne tadetatpravasitamacirānmānahaṃsairyadeṣā mastrairyadvā pravṛttaṃ virahavidhurimāliṃganāttadvadhūnāṃ || 89 || kṣārpyaṃbunidhiḥ śitidyutirapi prāsūta yasmātkathaṃ śubhrāṃśuśva sudhāmayaśva savidhustulyohi putraḥ pituḥ | āsīduttaramasya no'dya nṛpate ryasya prasarpadyaśaḥ pīyūṣaiḥ paripuṣṭa eṣa udadhistādṛgbhavaṃ stajjanau || 90 || lakṣmīmeṣaparāśritā mapibalā dākṛṣyabhogāspadaṃṃ prītyā svasya tanoti māṃ ca jananādapyekapatnīvratāṃ | svasmāddūrayati stutāṃ kavijanai rna śrotumutkaṃṭhate | kruddhetīva vipakṣabhūmimabhagatkīrti ryadīyoccakaiḥ || 91 || bāṇe mahīmaghavatosya tathā kṛpāṇe pāṇau sthitepyubhayamadbhutametadāsīt | eko dadhāva samare paralakṣyaheto ranyaḥ svakośamapi dūramudaujjhadeva || 92 || agādhaṃ pāthodhiṃ gurugarimasāraṃ suragiriṃ pṛthakkṛtvā vedhā na khalu kṛtakṛtyo mama mate | dvayaṃ nirmāyāsmin punarapi kilaikanna bhagavān tathā prītaḥ sṛṣṭiṃ vyathita na yathā tatpraṇayane || 93 || yatsauṃdaryavaśīkṛteva vijayaśrīkanyakā saṃgare sarvānapyapahāya rājatanujān daurbhāgyadagdhāniva | udvoḍhuṃ yamupāgatā karatalaṃ spṛṣṭvāpi sadyo mahaḥ | sūnuṃ kīrtisutāmasūta tadidaṃ loke mahatkautukaṃ || 94 || karṇāṭaśvadupāṭavaprakaṭano lāṭaḥ kapāṭaprada śyolastrāsavilolahṛt pārigaladdhījarjaro gurjaraḥ | aṃgaḥ saṃgararaṃgabhaṃguramatiḥ saṃpadyate sma kṣaṇāt | dikkukṣiṃbhari yatprayāṇapaṭahadhvāne samutsarpati || 95 || "gāṃbhīryeṇa vinirjitohamamune" tyaṃbhonidhe tvaṃ vṛthā khedaṃ māsma kṛthā janaḥ kila janaṃ dṛṣṭvā samāśvāsayet | sattvādhāratayā tathonnatatayā paśyaiṣa devā'calo jigye'nena tathā yathā nayanayo rhitvā gatī gocaraṃ || 96 || yāvatkartu mayaṃ vavāṃcha vilasatkodaṃḍa mārjau kare tāvadvairinṛpaḥ puṃraiva vilasatkodaṃḍamādhātpuraḥ | etasmātkathamanyathā
